episodes.title: I Fell in Love, and That's Why I Decided to Escape
episodes.synopsis: Yoshitake Shiraishi recalls his days in the Kabato Prison before the Russo-Japanese War. There, he encounters an imprisoned master forger, Chouan Kumagishi, who gives him a drawing of Sister Miyazawa, a woman well-known for visiting prisons across the country. Shiraishi's obsession with meeting the nun leads to a series of events that earn him the nickname Escape King.

To recover the garment, Asirpa, Saichi Sugimoto, Shiraishi, and Kiroranke must kill the monster that is attacking Eddie's horses.
